name: 4d-blog-engine
description: 4D Blog Engine — operationalizes the 4D AI Fluency Framework (Delegation, Description, Discernment, Diligence) for content production. v0.4.0 adds /blog-voice — a self-contained 8-question voice interview (derived from voice-architect) that produces <blog-project-dir>/<author-slug>-voice.md. Multi-voice supported: /blog-voice can be run repeatedly for guest contributors or co-writers, each producing their own slugged voice file. The pipeline's STEP 0 globs *-voice.md from the blog project directory — one voice file is used silently, multiple voice files trigger an

question. The plugin is fully decoupled from any preset voice (MoxyWolf or otherwise). /blog-init checks for voice files and offers to hand off to /blog-voice if none exist. Marker schema bumped to v4. v0.3.x stripped backend infrastructure out of the writer-facing setup. v0.2.0 added the lifecycle commands. Pipeline: takes a base document and an angle question; runs a 30-day discourse sweep across reddit, X, Hacker News, Substack, Facebook, Quora, podcasts, and academic sources; layers a /council:deliberate synthesis pass; builds a verified bibliography with AI-generated abstracts; drafts the blog post in the writer's voice using the research-pipeline content-writer; runs a two-tier anti-AI-slop pass (deterministic linter + LLM structural review with a second-pass audit); and ships through a nonce-bound Release Owner Gate scoring against a 100-point rubric. On a clean gate, produces a publication-ready blog post, a long-form LinkedIn article (full mirror, blog stays canonical), and a short hook-led LinkedIn teaser with a 3-axis scorecard. Trigger phrases: 'write a blog post from this document', 'derive a blog from this whitepaper', '/4d-blog-engine', 'set up the blog plugin', 'publish this post', 'release-owner gate'. Implements the Release Owner Gate from MoxyWolf's 'Beyond the Prompt' whitepaper.
